review.use_summary: Used MALT within eager/HOPS for ancient-pathogen screening against a stated 2017 database. Separately built a 91-spirochete custom index and screened 36214 sequencing datasets with MALT 0.5.2, BlastN/SemiGlobal, identity 90%, up to 25 alignments per query and 100000 per reference, followed by target extraction and a separate bacterial rescreen.
review.implementation_scope_note: The main article does not report the eager-screening MALT version. The 0.4.1 development adapter is a software control, not proof of the authors environment or the separate 0.5.2 role. The supplement reports 0.5.2 followed by superscript citation 61, not 0.5.261. Custom reference dates, accession mapping, aligned-read output and 130G/16-worker execution remain separate requirements; current small controls do not reproduce the historical analysis.
